description: Scans a declared set of non-sovereign artifacts and reports SHA drift, missing files, and stale receipts
hypothesis: A drift witness for non-sovereign artifacts will make autoresearch epoch health observable and replayable

gap_evidence.uncovered: EVAL_RECEIPT, FAILURE_CLUSTER, block receipts, epoch logs

necessity.evidence: coupling_witness covers only git-tracked sovereign files; epoch receipts and EVAL_RECEIPT JSONs have no drift detection

authority_safety.evidence: NONE — skill reads only non-sovereign paths; no write path to ledger/governance/schemas

failure_mode.evidence: SHA comparison could produce false positives if artifact format changes without content change; mitigated by content-hash, not format-hash

note: NON_SOVEREIGN dry-run only — not submitted to Mayor, requires operator countersign
